tasks.short: Answer patient call signals and determine their needs.

steps.what: Acknowledge patient call signals and identify the calling room or bedside.
Speak with or attend the patient to determine needs and seek nursing help.

tasks.design: Test native call-location display and staff acknowledgment in the {OTHER} nurse-call system. Present the correct room and an explicit acknowledgment state while retaining direct patient contact and human requests for nursing help.
tasks.previous_blocker: Call lights and room information may be displayed separately.
tasks.enabler_now: Supported nurse-call configuration can join location and acknowledgment.
tasks.still_hard: A call signal alone does not establish patient needs or clinical urgency.
tasks.human_edge: Recognize distress and seek the right help through direct contact.
tasks.altitude: Slightly less call-location lookup; care and escalation responsibilities stay unchanged.

reach.task: Relay a nonclinical assistance request to the correct team.
reach.learn: Ward routing and clinical escalation limits.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native nurse-call location and acknowledgment displays can reduce lookup without interpreting clinical need.

assumptions: Boundary ends with identifying the need or requesting nursing help; treatment and other care tasks are outside and unchanged. Patient contact keeps its full share.

Nurse-call controller supplies call_id, room_id, bed_id, timestamp and acknowledgment_state; ward coordinator supplies current staff routing. Missing or inconsistent location uses existing lights, intercom and direct attendance; no extraction or automated urgency classification.
Test native configuration before code. Notifications cannot silently clear calls; access and national employee consultation are included where applicable.
unknowns: Nurse-call compatibility, location accuracy and current acknowledgment process.
research_questions: Does the joined display reduce location lookup without delaying attendance or losing calls?

already_counted.description: Verify call location and acknowledge the signal.

incremental.description: Report incorrect routing or location labels.
Maintain room mappings and device access.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 R=94 gross=6 net=5 after 1 upkeep. Low: integrated display already present; high: separate room lookup removed. Patient conversation and attendance are unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Measure and record intake and output, reporting changes to nursing staff.

steps.what: Measure food and liquid intake or urinary and fecal output.
Record the measurement with patient, time, unit and observation context.
Report observed changes and measurement uncertainty to the responsible nurse.

tasks.design: Test native bedside intake-and-output forms in the {OTHER} clinical record system. Prefill verified patient and time context while the assistant enters the actual observation, confirms units and directly reports changes to the nurse.
tasks.previous_blocker: Measurements may be written locally and then copied into the patient record.
tasks.enabler_now: Native bedside forms can record the observation once in the correct encounter.
tasks.still_hard: Incomplete measurements and changes in the patient require direct observation and nursing judgement.
tasks.human_edge: Recognize that an apparently precise number may be an uncertain observation.

ambition.what: Make confirmed intake-and-output observations available to the nurse during the care round.

tasks.altitude: Less duplicate entry; measurement and reporting responsibilities stay unchanged.

reach.learn: Patient identification, units and uncertainty reporting within delegation.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native bedside forms can remove duplicate observation entry while measurement and clinical reporting remain human.
The digest flags Dutch DPIA requirements for large-scale health-data processing; this is privacy context rather than evidence of form capability.

assumptions: Boundary includes assistant measurement, recording and handover; nurse interpretation and treatment are outside and unchanged. No sensor or inferred measurement is introduced.

Clinical record team supplies patient_id, encounter_id and authorized staff access; assistant supplies observation_type, observed_time, value, unit, estimated_flag and context. Missing identity or units require manual confirmation before entry; no note extraction is assumed.

Native forms first. Context is prefilled only after positive patient identification. Access, privacy review and applicable national employee consultation are included; existing chart arithmetic earns no human saving.
unknowns: Bedside device access and existing duplicate entry.
Current observation fields and correction controls.
research_questions: Does direct entry preserve patient identity, units and explicit uncertainty without delaying care?

already_counted.description: Check patient, unit and observation entry before saving.

incremental.description: Report form defaults or patient-context problems.
Maintain approved forms and restricted access.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 R=87.5 gross=12.5 net=11.5 after 1 upkeep. Low: direct chart entry already used; high: local notes and later copying. Physical measurement and nurse reporting retain all time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Document patient observations and report them to nurses.

steps.what: Observe patient behavior, complaints and physical symptoms during care.
Document the observed behavior, complaint or symptom in the patient record.
Report the observations and unresolved concerns directly to the responsible nurse.

tasks.design: Test native observation templates in the {OTHER} clinical record system that retain the assistants own wording and patient quotations. Prefill verified encounter context, separate observations from interpretation and leave direct nurse reporting unchanged.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated context entry makes short observation notes cumbersome.
tasks.enabler_now: Native encounter-linked forms can remove repeated headings without generating clinical meaning.
tasks.still_hard: Subtle changes and patient complaints require attentive listening and human escalation.
tasks.human_edge: Notice a meaningful change and communicate what was actually observed rather than a guessed diagnosis.
tasks.altitude: Less note formatting; observational responsibility and escalation rights stay unchanged.

reach.task: Relay a factual patient concern to nursing staff.
reach.learn: Observation versus interpretation and escalation boundaries.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: encounter-linked templates can reduce repeated context entry without generating or diagnosing symptoms.

assumptions: Boundary is assistant observation and communication; nurse assessment and treatment are outside and unchanged. This note excludes the numerical intake-output entries counted separately.

Clinical record system supplies patient_id, encounter_id and author_id; assistant supplies observed_time, factual_observation, patient_quote, uncertainty and person_contacted. Missing identity or uncertain observations require direct clarification, not model completion.

Test native templates first. Free-text observation remains authored and checked by the assistant. Urgent communication follows existing procedure without waiting for note completion; listed steps describe routine documentation order.
unknowns: Existing templates and repeated context-entry burden.
research_questions: Can a shorter form preserve factual detail and distinguish patient words from staff interpretation?

already_counted.description: Check the factual note before saving.

incremental.description: Report misleading template defaults or missing context.
Maintain approved observation templates and access.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 R=90 gross=10 net=9 after 1 upkeep. Low: current template already concise; high: repeated context entry removed. Observation and direct nurse handover retain all time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Review dietary restrictions, allergies and preferences before appropriate meal support.

steps.what: Retrieve current dietary restrictions, food allergies and recorded patient preferences.
Compare the intended diet with restrictions and clarify any conflicting instructions.
Confirm patient preferences and communicate the reviewed dietary requirements to meal staff.

tasks.design: Test a native diet-and-allergy view in the {OTHER} clinical record system that shows current authorized instructions and their dates together. The assistant still resolves conflicts with the nurse and confirms patient preferences; the display does not select a clinical diet or certify a prepared meal.
tasks.previous_blocker: Diet instructions, allergies and preferences may be on separate record pages.
tasks.enabler_now: Native record views can join the latest authorized fields without model inference.
tasks.still_hard: Conflicting instructions, changing preferences and actual meal ingredients need human clarification.
tasks.human_edge: Notice when a technically available diet does not match the patients current needs or wishes.

ambition.what: Give meal staff a clearly dated dietary-support handover before the next meal round.

tasks.altitude: Less record hunting; no authority to change dietary prescriptions or allergy records is gained.

reach.task: Communicate a patients meal preferences within the approved diet.
reach.learn: Preference versus restriction and referral boundaries.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: a joined current diet-and-allergy view can shorten retrieval while clinical interpretation stays with authorized staff.

assumptions: Boundary is reviewing and communicating dietary requirements, excluding diet prescription, meal preparation and final meal handover. Those actions are not assigned to software or included as savings.

Authorized clinical staff supply patient_id, diet_code, restrictions, allergy_status, instruction_version, author and effective_time; assistant records confirmed preferences; meal team supplies intended meal description. Missing, unknown or conflicting data require direct nurse clarification, not an inferred safe diet.
Native configuration first. Joined fields retain source versions and unknown states. Privacy/access review and applicable national employee consultation are included.
unknowns: Record versioning and the current division of dietary review responsibilities.
research_questions: Does the view make conflicting or unknown instructions obvious instead of presenting a false all-clear?

already_counted.description: Verify the current diet and allergy source versions.

incremental.description: Report stale source links or conflicting view fields.
Maintain authorized record mappings and access.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 R=85 gross=15 net=14 after 1 upkeep. Low: fields already joined; high: separate record pages. Conflict resolution and patient communication remain unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Reduce limited record lookup and duplicate entry while protecting direct patient contact and nursing accountability.
role.ambitious_version: A nursing assistant who gives clear timely observations and notices uncertainty without turning record convenience into clinical authority.
